text:
olivia.hr: Help needed  spouse scheduled an MRI while we're visiting family in Belgium next week. Clinic says they need pre-auth and the member doesn't have the digital ID yet. Can benefits confirm coverage and issue an authorization to avoid upfront payment?
sam.benefits: Hi Olivia  can you share member name, DOB, last4 of member ID, clinic name/address, requested service date, and CPT code (MRI code if known)?
olivia.hr: Member: Priya Kapoor / DOB 1987-12-03 / last4 1203. Clinic: Radiologie Centrale, Rue de la Loi 45, Brussels. Date: 2029-07-14. CPT: 70551 (MRI brain w/o contrast).
dr s-clinic: [clinic] We can accept an auth number and will bill directly if provided; email our billing at billing@radiologiecentral.be. We also need member full name and DOB on the auth letter.
sam.benefits: Opening case with Aetna Intl. We typically need full member ID; last4 may be sufficient to start. SLA for imaging pre-auth ~2 business days. Tagging aetna-bot.
aetna-bot: [auto] Created case INT-IM-44122. Please supply full member ID or SSN last4, clinical indication/diagnosis, and any prior imaging. Expected turn around 48-72 hours.
olivia.hr: Clinical reason: persistent headaches post-concussion, referral note attached. Full member ID will be emailed privately.
sam.benefits: Got the attachment. Requesting a "letter of guarantee" + pre-auth number and emailing the clinic billing contact. If clinic still asks for a physical card, provide the pre-auth and carrier contact.
dan.finance: Note: if member pays and submits for reimbursement, finance can fast-track reimbursement if labeled "medical-travel" with receipts and proof of payment. Keep originals.
aetna-bot: [auto] Update INT-IM-44122: Preliminary auth PA-2029-07-220 issued pending review. Letter of guarantee to be emailed to member and clinic within 24 hours.
olivia.hr: Clinic confirmed receipt of the auth email and will schedule for 7/14. Thanks everyone. I'll upload confirmation to HRA international records.
sam.benefits: Marking resolved here. Reopen if the clinic requests additional provider credentialing or if member gets billed.
